faults.page says: The 2024 report names the organisation Korporativnyi fond "Almaty Museum of Arts" (non-profit, Law on Non-Commercial Organisations). The 2021 report says its earlier name was Chastnyi fond (private fund), renamed 24.08.2022, so the current form is a corporate fund and neither page says private foundation. Same inference as the first-pass ruling; the 2021 page shows the Chastnyi fond wording is the superseded form.

faults.stored: The museum's own 2024 funds-use report names the organisation as the corporate fund (korporativny fond) Almaty Museum of Arts, a non-profit financed by founder contributions, and its 2021 report gives the earlier name Private Fund Private Museum of Contemporary Art.
faults.page says: Describes the superseded private fund name as support for the form; no governance block remains.

History page only recounts Resolution No. 675 of 2 July 2013 creating a republican state institution; it does not show that form is still in force. The anti-corruption page uses the abbreviation RSE (republican state enterprise) in a project-office heading, a different form from state institution, and states no legal form. The researcher's reading is an inference. Same inference as the first-pass ruling and no cited page states what that checker found missing.

faults.page says: The anti-corruption page names the Ministry of Culture and Sports in an RSE heading, but with legal_form unsupported the governance block drops (step 6).

faults.stored: The museum's history page says Government Resolution No. 675 of 2 July 2013 created the republican state institution of the Ministry of Culture, and its anti-corruption page still styles it a republican state enterprise of the Ministry of Culture and Sports, so the form is read as a government body under that ministry.
faults.page says: States the form is 'read as' a government body, which is inference.

faults.stored: ... lists an executive board of ten members.
faults.page says: The Arabic about page lists eleven names under the executive board (al-majlis al-tanfidhi). The legal form is stated: the page opens 'Beirut Art Center (BAC) is a non-profit association (jam'iyya la tabtaghi al-ribh)', which is the text the first-pass checker found missing from the English page, so the governance block stands.

corrected.basis: The Arabic about page of the centre calls it a non-profit association (jam'iyya la tabtaghi al-ribh) and lists an executive board of eleven members.

note: Last page of the museum's own 2021 strategy PDF (creation date 2021-10-06) gives MO muziejus, VšĮ, company code 302325629. Mapping VšĮ to private nonprofit rests on the form's non-profit status; the PDF names no founders.
